content.title: Watch Inside Out Classic: Washington Capitals vs. New York Rangers On Disney+ April 5th 2026 | Explore Disney+
content.text: How to watch the altcast, broadcast from inside Riley’s mind! Hockey Island is hosting an epic showdown, with her Emotions skating alongside animated versions of NHL playersIf you’ve ever watched a game and thought, “This needs more Joy, a dash of Anxiety, and maybe a little Sadness,” you’re in luck. On April 5 at 7pm ET / 4pm PT, get ready for an emotional showdown as Riley’s emotions team up with the Washington Capitals and New York Rangers for an animated, live hockey game showcased in real-time on Disney+. This is the type of sports game that will surprise and delight the whole family. Read on for everything you need to know.When is the Inside Out Classic altcast for the Capitals vs. Rangers NHL game?Inside Out Classic, Disney+, ESPNThe Capitals vs. Rangers altcast goes live April 5 at 7pm ET / 4pm PT.Where (and how) can you watch the Inside Out Classic altcast for the Capitals vs. Rangers NHL game?You can stream it live on Disney+.Will the altcast be available to stream if I miss it live?Yep! It'll be available to replay on Disney+ right after it ends.What is the Inside Out Classic altcast exactly and how does it work? Inside Out Classic, Disney+, ESPNInside Out Classic features real-time animation of the action between the Washington Capitals and the New York Rangers, modeled after characters on Pixar’s award-winning Inside Out franchise.This feature blends two types of tracking technologies, NHL EDGE positional data (NHL Puck and Player Tracking) and Sony’s Hawk-Eye Innovations’ optical tracking, to create dynamic player and character movement so fans can watch detailed limb and stick movement and mannerisms come to life in animated form.Is the whole Capitals vs. Rangers NHL game going to be animated?Yes! The match is an animated NHL game with players virtually generated in real time to match their movements on the ice. So you can watch the real game through an Inside Out lens instead of a standard broadcast camera.Is there a story behind the Inside Out altcast?Dream Productions, Disney+Live from Hockey Island deep inside Riley’s mind, this altcast is one of her Dream Productions, featuring the Washington Capitals taking on the New York Rangers. Her Emotions are part of the action as the teams battle it out on the rink. In case you didn’t know, Dream Productions is the studio inside Riley’s mind where dreams really do come true, every night, on time and on budget! Stream Pixar’s Dream Productions to find out more.Who’s behind bringing this NHL altcast to life?The Inside Out Classic is brought to you by ESPN, Disney, Pixar, and the National Hockey League.Where can I watch Inside Out, Inside Out 2, and Dream Productions?If you want to get to know the characters before the puck drop, Inside Out and Inside Out 2 are streaming now on Disney+. Dream Productions is too, set between the two movies, the show offers a behind-the-scenes look at where and how Riley’s dreams are made.Which Inside Out and Dream Productions characters appear during the Capitals vs. Rangers NHL game?Inside Out 2, Disney+Expect to see your favorite Emotions from the movies and supporting characters, including:JoyJoy makes sure Riley is happy. Working alongside the other Emotions, Joy always looks on the bright side and tries to make every situation a positive one.SadnessSadness reminds us that even the quieter Emotions have plenty to say. She knows there’s value in slowing down and feeling things fully, and she brings that same spirit to the match.AnxietyAnxiety, one of the most common sports-related emotions, tries her best to protect Riley from the dangers she can’t see. She’s frazzled, fast, and planning for every possible outcome.Other Inside Out VoicesBe sure to listen closely as some of your favorite Inside Out characters are returning to voice their roles during the altcast, including Phyllis Smith (Sadness), Lewis Black (Anger), Tony Hale (Fear), and Maya Hawke (Anxiety).Explore More Behind The Scenes With The Mind WorkersWhat other altcasts have been on Disney+ before?Dunk the Halls 2025Dunk The Halls, Disney+, ESPNIn December, the Cavaliers vs. Knicks Christmas Day game was animated live on a virtual Main Street, USA. Learn more about Dunk the Halls.Monsters Funday Football 2025Monsters Funday Football, Disney+, ESPNMike and Sulley from Pixar’s Monsters, Inc. teamed up with the Eagles and Chargers for a live altcast at Monsters, Inc. headquarters in Monstropolis. In an exclusive interview with the creators, we learned how the altcast magic happens.Simpsons Funday Football 2024Simpsons Funday Football, Disney+, ESPNSpringfield’s Atoms Stadium hosted the Dallas Cowboys and Cincinnati Bengals in an altcast that scored multiple Sports Emmy® nominations.Dunk the Halls 2024Dunk The Halls, Disney+, ESPNThe Knicks and Spurs tipped off on a virtual Main Street, USA, with Mickey and friends joining the action. It was the first animated presentation of an NBA game, and the first NBA game to stream on Disney+.Big City Greens Classic 2024Big City Greens Classic 2, Disney+, ESPNThe second Classic sent the Penguins and Bruins into Times Circle, with Cricket coaching Pittsburgh and Gramma behind the Bruins bench. Intermission even got its own animated skills competition.Toy Story Funday Football 2023 Toy Story Funday Football, Disney+, ESPNThe altcast that started it all, featuring the Atlanta Falcons, Jacksonville Jaguars, and everyone’s favorite characters from Pixar’s Toy Story earned three Sports Emmys® for Production Design, Technical Achievement, and Graphic Design.Big City Greens Classic 2023Big City Greens Classic, Disney+, ESPN The Capitals and Rangers faced off in the first live, animated NHL game telecast, with players reimagined as Big City Greens-style characters in real time.
